exposure.method: For each account that received traced funds, its own balance is followed from the first traced receipt to 72 h later. Upper bound: no more than was received, and no more than actually left the account. Ranges are per account and must not be added across hops.
limitations: The observed downstream total counts the same money each time it moves; it is not a loss figure.
Balances combine funds from many sources; no method can prove which rupees were the victim's.
Exposure is computed for up to 60 downstream accounts.
